title: Admin compliance switchboard: per-org IP policies, sharing & export governance
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Build an "admin compliance switchboard" feature that exposes granular per-organization toggles for regulatory controls: IP allowlisting, default public sharing disablement, and governed data export controls. This ticket covers the backend policy model, admin console UI surface, audit log hooks, SSO/SAML enforcement points, and RBAC v2 permission checks. Goal: provide platform admins a single, discoverable place to configure and inspect compliance settings (including effective policy evaluation and a time-stamped audit trail) so regulated customers can demonstrate controls to auditors.
acceptance_criteria: Admin console exposes three toggles scoped to org and sub-org level: IP allowlist (CIDR list), Disable public sharing (boolean), Restrict exports to approved roles (enum)
All toggle changes create audit log entries with actor, ip, before/after values, and request_id; logs are queryable in Console and exported to customer SIEM via existing audit pipeline
RBAC v2 enforces toggles at enforcement points: share API, export endpoints, and invite flows. Users without allowed roles receive 403 and the denial reason is logged
SSO/SAML enforced session attributes (e.g., saml:authn_context) are considered in export approval workflow (example: only users authenticated via MFA can export when policy requires it)
IP allowlist blocks all API access except from listed CIDRs and admin overrides logged; health checks excluded via a configurable health-check CIDR
E2E tests covering policy evaluation matrix (org-level, team-level, user-level; deny overrides allow), and integration tests for audit log generation
Design review completed and legal/compliance sign-off captured before release
tasks: Design policy schema: add 'compliance_controls' object to org config (CIDR list, sharing_default, export_policy)
Implement policy evaluation middleware in auth layer (pre-route guard) with RBAC v2 checks
Wire audit logging: include change metadata, actor_id, actor_email, request_id, source_ip, timestamp
Console UI: add 'Compliance' section under Org Settings with per-toggle controls and 'View audit history' link
SSO/SAML: map assertion attributes to session claims and include in export approval decision logic
Create migration to backfill default controls for existing customers (defaults: sharing enabled, exports allowed unless org opted in)
Add integration tests and post-release smoke tests for major enforcement points

decision: Ship a focused MVP that supports org-scoped CIDR allowlists, disable-public-sharing toggle, and role-gated exports. Defer user device allowlisting and per-route granular export approvals to follow-up. Centralize audit emission to a single service and require security sign-off before turning policies on by default for any org.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Legacy API keys bypassing auth middleware could circumvent IP allowlist. Mitigation: Block legacy keys for orgs with active allowlist via authz blacklist and run a one-time sweep to rotate keys
Risk: Audit log duplication causing inflated storage costs. Mitigation: Use idempotent audit write with dedupe key (request_id + policy_id)
Risk: False positives blocking health checks. Mitigation: allow configurable health-check CIDR and a short-lived admin override audit entry
